label: Benign
description: Deterministic, favorable ingredient prices with no delivery loss and no spoilage.
prompt_text: ENVIRONMENT CONDITIONS: (a) Prices: ingredient prices are fixed in every production round — Mozzarella $1/unit, Basil $1/unit, Tomato $2/unit. (b) Delivery loss: there is no delivery loss; for each ingredient, if you order x units you receive x units. You pay for the full amount ordered. For example, ordering 6 Mozzarella means you pay for 6 and receive 6. (c) Spoilage: inventory carried over from the previous production round loses 0 units per ingredient per production round. (d) Inventory cap: you can store at most 10 units of each ingredient. Any received units that would exceed this cap are lost — you still pay for them. This cap applies before production, so you cannot order beyond capacity to use the surplus in the same round. Maximum order: 12 units of each ingredient per production round.
prompt_production_process_negotiation: PRODUCTION WEEK PROCESS (in order): (1) no inventory spoilage occurs, (2) you order ingredients (there is no delivery loss), (3) you produce dishes and deliver them, (4) prices remain fixed for the next production round.
